text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I'd better check my shift<n>times.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I've still got a few gaps<n>around here. I
should be able to fit in<n>a one-time gig, at least. But
then...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I try to squeeze in more work, it<n>means I'll have
less time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. I wish I could just be energeticall the time without having to rest...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Ines Fujin is still a bit<n>worn out from
her races. I might have<n>to rearrange her upcoming
race<n>schedule.
